AVIATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.

2. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

8. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

13. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

14. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

15. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

----
